steps.textCn: 另一侧重复同样操作。

name: Cross Wing
blurb: This plane is small and fast, allowing it to go wherever you want.
description: Its size and heavy nose makes it one of the better flying paper airplanes.  Bend two wingtips up and the other two down for a dramatic look.

steps.text: Fold the paper in half by bringing the top to the bottom.
steps.textCn: Fold the paper in half by bringing the top to the bottom.

steps.text: Fold in half the other direction, making a crease and then unfold.
steps.textCn: Fold in half the other direction, making a crease and then unfold.

steps.text: Fold the top corners to the center line so that the crease goes through to the bottom corners.
steps.textCn: Fold the top corners to the center line so that the crease goes through to the bottom corners.

steps.text: Unfold the last step and accordion fold the corners inside.
steps.textCn: Unfold the last step and accordion fold the corners inside.

steps.text: Fold the top corners to the center line.
steps.textCn: Fold the top corners to the center line.

steps.text: Fold the tip back about one inch (2.5cm).
steps.textCn: Fold the tip back about one inch (2.5cm).

name: Royal Wing
blurb: A flying airfoil with almost no fuselage.
description: This is an advanced glider that floats slowly away from you if adjusted correctly. Read the notes at the bottom for tips.

steps.text: Holding the paper sidesways, fold the paper in half and unfold.
steps.textCn: Holding the paper sidesways, fold the paper in half and unfold.

steps.text: Fold down the top right corner down to the end of the crease you just made.
steps.textCn: Fold down the top right corner down to the end of the crease you just made.

steps.text: Open the last fold and repeat with the other side to get the creases shown.
steps.textCn: Open the last fold and repeat with the other side to get the creases shown.

steps.text: Next, accordion fold the two corners in and the center out to get this diamond shape.
steps.textCn: Next, accordion fold the two corners in and the center out to get this diamond shape.

steps.text: Fold the front two flaps up.
steps.textCn: Fold the front two flaps up.

steps.text: Continue folding the two flaps behind the top edge.
steps.textCn: Continue folding the two flaps behind the top edge.

name: Star Wing
blurb: This plane is made to have long wings and a very small body.
description: This is a difficult design to perfect and often doesnt work, but it looks cool and if you adjust it correctly you can get it to do some fun tricks.

steps.text: Fold the paper in half in both directions, forming 4 equal rectangles. Unfold.
steps.textCn: Fold the paper in half in both directions, forming 4 equal rectangles. Unfold.

steps.text: Fold the top corners to the center horizontal line.
steps.textCn: Fold the top corners to the center horizontal line.

steps.text: Fold the top point down to the bottom edge.
steps.textCn: Fold the top point down to the bottom edge.

steps.text: Fold the top corners to the bottom of each side.
steps.textCn: Fold the top corners to the bottom of each side.

steps.text: Fold the paper airplane in half towards you.
steps.textCn: Fold the paper airplane in half towards you.

steps.text: Fold out each side to create the wings. The body should be about a 2cm (3/4 inch) tall.
steps.textCn: Fold out each side to create the wings. The body should be about a 2cm (3/4 inch) tall.

name: The Sprinter
blurb: This odd looking paper airplane has a large stabilizing tail fin.
description: The wings will flap at certain angles, so experiment with it and throw gently. This design is sensitive to asymmetries and takes some small adjustments to work well.

steps.text: Fold the paper in half diagonally so opposite corners meet.
steps.textCn: Fold the paper in half diagonally so opposite corners meet.

steps.text: Fold the long edge about 3/4 inch (19 mm).
steps.textCn: Fold the long edge about 3/4 inch (19 mm).

steps.text: Fold the paper in half towards you and then rotate so that the thickest point is facing up.  The squared off point will be facing to the left.
steps.textCn: Fold the paper in half towards you and then rotate so that the thickest point is facing up.  The squared off point will be facing to the left.

steps.text: Fold the right side over and line it up with the left side and make a vertical crease.
steps.textCn: Fold the right side over and line it up with the left side and make a vertical crease.

steps.text: Fold the other side down so opposite sides meet.
steps.textCn: Fold the other side down so opposite sides meet.

steps.text: Now, fold one outer flap down to create the first wing. The body will be about 3/4 inch (19 mm) tall.
steps.textCn: Now, fold one outer flap down to create the first wing. The body will be about 3/4 inch (19 mm) tall.

name: Water Plane
blurb: This paper airplane is made to look like a boat.
description: It glides through the air like a boat glides through water, slow and smooth.

steps.text: Fold the paper in half and then fold in half again.
steps.textCn: Fold the paper in half and then fold in half again.

steps.text: Open the previous folds up. Mark a point about 4 inches (10cm) down from the top and fold down along that point.
steps.textCn: Open the previous folds up. Mark a point about 4 inches (10cm) down from the top and fold down along that point.

steps.text: Fold the top two corners in to the closest crease.
steps.textCn: Fold the top two corners in to the closest crease.

steps.text: Unfold and then accordion fold the top corners into the inside.
steps.textCn: Unfold and then accordion fold the top corners into the inside.

steps.text: Fold the two outer flaps in to the center line.
steps.textCn: Fold the two outer flaps in to the center line.

steps.text: Fold the airplane in half towards you.
steps.textCn: Fold the airplane in half towards you.
